subject: general
question: In May 2022, Then President Ram Nath Kovind appointed ________ as the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinai Kumar Saxena **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinai Kumar Saxena was appointed** as the **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi in May 2022 by President Ram Nath Kovind.**
 
• Vinai Kumar Saxena** is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1983 batch from the Assam-Meghalaya cadre.**
 
• He **has served as the Chairman of the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA**) and the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) in the past.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Bedi:**

 
 
• Kiran Bedi is a **retired Indian Police Service (IPS) officer, social activist, and politician**.
 
• She is **known for being the first woman officer in the IPS.**
 
• She served in various high-profile positions in the police force and is recognized for her reforms in the prison system.
 
• **Kiran Bedi has also been involved in several social causes and was the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry from 2016 to 2021.**
 
 
 
• **Anil Baijal:**
 
 
• Anil Baijal is a **retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer and the current Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.**
 
• He **took office in 2016, succeeding Najeeb Jung.**
 
• Before** becoming the Lieutenant Governor, he held various important administrative positions, including Secretary in the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of Urban Development.**
 
 
 
• **Vijai Kapoor**:
 
 
• Vijai Kapoor is** a former Lieutenant Governor of Delh**i who served from 1997 to 2002.
 
• **He is an IAS officer by training **and has held several key positions in the government of India.
 
• During his tenure, **he played a significant role in the administration and governance of Delhi.**
